post.title: How an average car loan costs almost $9,000 in interest
post.ig:
An average-size car loan can cost almost $9,000 in interest.

In Q2 2026, the average new-car loan was $43,610 at 6.35% (Experian).
Example: over 72 months that's $730 a month and $8,948 in interest. At 84 months, $644 a month but $10,521 in interest.
More than 35% of new-car loans ran longer than six years in Q2 2026.
Same loan at 4.41% vs 13.52%: about $6,100 vs $20,300 in interest.

Sources: Experian State of the Automotive Finance Market, Q2 2026. Example math: standard amortization, fixed rate, no fees.
